title: IVCF Filter Detection using AI
abstract: Deep learning models (e.g., Swin-UNet) to detect and segment inferior vena cava filters on CT, enabling automated registry curation and complication monitoring.

title: PDAC Diagnosis using Deep Learning
abstract: Supervised 2D/3D CNNs on CT for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma detection and treatment outcome prediction; interpretable models for clinical use.

title: PDAC and scRNA-seq Analysis
abstract: Single-cell RNA-seq integration to characterize PDAC tumor microenvironment; pathway and trajectory analysis to identify actionable targets.

title: CABG Outcomes (On-pump vs Off-pump)
abstract: Retrospective analysis of CABG outcomes using ML for risk stratification and protocol optimization across institutional cohorts.

title: RAG in Healthcare
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation for clinical documentation and patient education; guardrails and privacy-aware pipelines for safe deployment.
